functionalRequirement: A surface app page shall provide a customer with all customer system functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The surface app page must include 100% of the customer system functionalities as defined in the system requirements.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR explicitly states that the page must provide all customer system functionality, necessitating full coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The surface app page must allow users to access all functionalities with no more than 3 clicks from the main interface.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies ease of access to all functionalities, requiring efficient navigation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The surface app page must include confirmation dialogs for actions that cannot be undone, such as deleting data or canceling subscriptions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves providing all functionalities, which may include critical actions requiring user error protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The surface app page must load all functionalities within 2 seconds for 95% of users under normal network conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires providing all functionalities, necessitating fast loading times for usability.

functionalRequirement: System shall display information and settings related to the required setting based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must display the correct information and settings for 100% of valid user inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires accurate display of information and settings based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Self-descriptiveness: The system must provide clear labels and tooltips for all displayed information and settings to ensure users understand their purpose.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves displaying information and settings, which should be self-explanatory for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must display the required information and settings within 500 milliseconds of receiving user input.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires real-time display of information based on user input, necessitating quick response times.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available to display information and settings for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to information and settings, requiring high availability.

functionalRequirement: If the validation fails, system shall prompt "Wrong OTP".

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must display the "Wrong OTP" prompt for 100% of failed OTP validation attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR explicitly requires the system to prompt this message on validation failure.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must allow users to retry OTP entry at least 3 times before locking the account temporarily.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling validation failure, requiring protection against user errors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resistance: The system must prevent brute force attacks by locking the account after 3 failed OTP attempts for 5 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves OTP validation, which requires protection against security threats.

functionalRequirement: Information on remaining job posting time and CV access shall be reportable.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate reports containing all required information on remaining job posting time and CV access for 100% of specified use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide reportable information, necessitating full coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate reports within 5 seconds for up to 1,000 concurrent requests.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating reports, which should be timely for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for generating and exporting reports in multiple formats (e.g., PDF, CSV).
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves report generation, requiring ease of use for users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must ensure that CV access information is only visible to authorized users and encrypted during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive CV data, requiring protection against unauthorized access.
